inputs: Pinned delivery contract and bundle manifest
Actual evidence set and deployment readback for final verification
deterministicChecks: Reject duplicate JSON keys before schema evaluation
Read retained artifact bytes independently and verify every pin
Check flight and step DAGs and guarded data-flow contracts
Expand exact required criterion and qualification-instance sets from retained scope
Match evaluated sets exactly; reject omissions, duplicates, substitutions and stale revisions
Validate scoped certificates with pinned checker identity, assumptions and bounds
Independently read deployed publication and runtime evidence for final obligations
Reconcile blocking semantic-review findings without letting inference supply authority
Emit a complete typed GateReceipt; refuse or return INCONCLUSIVE on missing authority/evidence
Enforce exact qualification profile set, unique use-case IDs/titles, typed invocation conflict/recovery and observation/replay joins
Validate deployed browser origin/release/readback, source attempts, generation provenance and model receipt digests

localToolAuthority: Diagnostics and scoped formal evidence only; these tools are not yet an admitted OV3 evaluator.

existingCapabilityLimits.ask-model: Declared inference transport; semantic review is advisory.
existingCapabilityLimits.ask-system-one: Declared typed-decision transport; classifications do not establish semantic correctness or authority.
existingCapabilityLimits.assess-verification-evidence: Explicitly labels input CALLER_SUPPLIED and authorization NOT_EVALUATED; cannot authorize this gate.
existingCapabilityLimits.verify-objective-fulfillment: Existing publication-oriented verifier; its current public schema does not carry this product contract, flights and qualification matrix. Reuse requires a proved extension/composition.

authorityRule: Only the admitted verifier's actual execution, bound to its declared digest/profile and independent retained readback, can produce an authoritative gate result. Receipt field values alone never prove origin.
checkerTrustObligation: FP00 must qualify the evaluator with positive and negative controls, independent review or a checked certificate, and fresh hosted invocations. A model-authored checker or passing local test alone is insufficient.
preparationRoute: FP00: retain/discover -> author -> independently qualify -> admit via existing authority -> hosted controls/readback -> semantic review -> admitted definition verifier. G-PREPARATION does not require G-DEFINITION.
